description: Source code for the Android Graphics Buffer Mapper implementation, managing buffer import, locking, unlocking, and querying buffer properties within the Android graphics system.

classes.name: GraphicBufferMapper
classes.description: Singleton class providing an interface for managing graphics buffers, including import, lock, unlock, and property retrieval functions.

methods.name: preloadHal
methods.description: Preloads the HAL gralloc mappers for versions 2 through 5.

methods.name: GraphicBufferMapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the appropriate gralloc mapper based on availability.

methods.name: dumpBuffer
methods.description: Appends a buffer's dump information to a string.

methods.name: dumpBufferToSystemLog
methods.description: Logs buffer dump information to the system log.

methods.name: importBuffer
methods.description: Imports a buffer handle with validation of size and format.

methods.name: importBufferNoValidate
methods.description: Imports a buffer handle without validation.

methods.name: getTransportSize
methods.description: Retrieves transport size info for a buffer handle.

methods.name: freeBuffer
methods.description: Frees a buffer handle.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a buffer for access, returning a pointer to its memory.

methods.name: lockYCbCr
methods.description: Locks a buffer for YCbCr access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a buffer handle.

methods.name: lockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously locks a buffer with specified usage and bounds.

methods.name: lockAsyncYCbCr
methods.description: Asynchronously locks a buffer for YCbCr access.

methods.name: unlockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously unlocks a buffer, returning a fence file descriptor.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a buffer configuration is supported.

methods.name: getBufferId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID of a buffer.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name associated with a buffer.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Gets the width of a buffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Gets the height of a buffer.

methods.name: getLayerCount
methods.description: Gets the layer count of a buffer.

methods.name: getPixelFormatRequested
methods.description: Retrieves the requested pixel format of a buffer.

methods.name: getPixelFormatFourCC
methods.description: Retrieves the FourCC pixel format code.

methods.name: getPixelFormatModifier
methods.description: Retrieves the pixel format modifier.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Retrieves the usage flags of a buffer.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the allocation size of a buffer.

methods.name: getProtectedContent
methods.description: Checks if buffer contains protected content.

methods.name: getCompression
methods.description: Retrieves compression info for a buffer.

methods.name: getInterlaced
methods.description: Retrieves interlacing info for a buffer.

methods.name: getChromaSiting
methods.description: Retrieves chroma siting info for a buffer.

methods.name: getPlaneLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves plane layout information.

methods.name: getDataspace
methods.description: Retrieves dataspace info.

methods.name: setDataspace
methods.description: Sets dataspace info.

methods.name: getBlendMode
methods.description: Retrieves blend mode.

methods.name: getSmpte2086
methods.description: Retrieves SMPTE 2086 color info.

methods.name: setSmpte2086
methods.description: Sets SMPTE 2086 color info.

methods.name: getCta861_3
methods.description: Retrieves CTA-861.3 info.

methods.name: setCta861_3
methods.description: Sets CTA-861.3 info.

methods.name: getSmpte2094_40
methods.description: Retrieves SMPTE 2094-40 info.

methods.name: setSmpte2094_40
methods.description: Sets SMPTE 2094-40 info.

methods.name: getSmpte2094_10
methods.description: Retrieves SMPTE 2094-10 info.

methods.name: setSmpte2094_10
methods.description: Sets SMPTE 2094-10 info.
